articles.author: Silexion Therapeutics Corp
articles.headline: Silexion Therapeutics Reports Positive Preclinical Findings for SIL204, Demonstrating Key Mechanism for Endogenous Systemic Uptake in KRAS-Driven Cancers
articles.summary: Silexion reports cellular uptake and KRAS gene-silencing findings for SIL204 using physiological serum lipids in a preclinical translational assay. These laboratory findings do not establish clinical efficacy in patients or regulatory approval.

articles.headline: Silexion Therapeutics Announces Exercise of Warrants
articles.summary: Silexion announces agreements for exercise of existing warrants at a reduced $0.2603 price, with approximately $837,366 expected gross proceeds and issuance of additional warrants. The financing is dilutive and expected to close subject to customary conditions; it is not treated as cash already received.
